summary: Tested Internal Cost Center / Create Internal Event functionality. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified - Create Internal Event button, form with pre-filled data, internal events appearing in Event Orchestration with Committed badge, and Linked Marketing Activation banner.

create_internal_event_button.details: Button 'Create Internal Event (Cost Center)' appears in Link to Event dialog with description 'For internal marketing activations without external client'

create_internal_event_form.details: Form shows: Event Name (pre-filled from activation), Date, Budget (pre-filled), Notes. Cost Center info banner displays 'This event will be created as internal marketing investment'

form_prefill.details: Form correctly pre-fills Event Name from activation.name and Budget from activation.budget

internal_event_stage_committed.details: Created internal events automatically get stage='Committed' and appear immediately in Event Orchestration

internal_cost_center_client.details: GET /api/demand-studio/internal-cost-center creates/returns client 'Marketing Interno - {Org Name}' with is_internal_cost_center=true

internal_events_in_orchestration.details: Internal events display in Event Orchestration with 'Committed' badge and client 'Marketing Interno - My Company'

linked_activation_banner.details: Event Orchestration shows 'Linked Marketing Activation' banner with activation name (xtz), Marketing Budget ($10,000), and 'View Activation' button

event_activation_bidirectional_link.details: Created internal events are automatically linked to their source activation, and activation shows 'Linked Event' section

backend_create_internal_event_endpoint.details: POST /api/demand-studio/activations/{id}/create-internal-event creates event with is_internal_event=true, stage='Committed', and links bidirectionally

backend_internal_cost_center_endpoint.details: GET /api/demand-studio/internal-cost-center is idempotent - returns same client on multiple calls

context_for_next_testing_agent: Internal Cost Center / Create Internal Event feature fully functional.
